definition: Selecting a facility location to reduce exposure to identified natural hazards. Merely locating infrastructure in a vulnerable area is insufficient.
Selecting or modifying a linear infrastructure route to reduce natural-hazard exposure. Relocation may also qualify when an existing or previously planned route is moved.
Moving existing or previously planned infrastructure away from an identified hazard. Excludes initial site selection without relocation.
Geographically separating critical facilities to reduce common-event failure. Recovery capability is disaster_recovery and requires separate evidence.
Choosing a deployment mode because of natural hazards, such as buried rather than aerial cable or satellite rather than terrestrial infrastructure. Excludes adding a backup path alone.
